gbm_population_evidence.quote: A confirmed GBM diagnosis must be based on local review of tumor tissue from the initial biopsy, surgery, or re-resection.

candidate_evidence.quote: Berubicin HCl is a novel synthetic anthracycline with a chemical structure similar to doxorubicin HCl

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Recurrent or progressive GBM as evaluated by central review applying RANO criteria

role_evidence.quote: Berubicin intravenously infused will be administered at a dose of 7.1 mg/m2 as free base as a 2 hour intravenous (IV) infusion once daily for 3 consecutive days

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational anthracycline (topoisomerase II inhibitor) that crosses the blood-brain barrier
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: novel synthetic anthracycline, cytotoxic topoisomerase II inhibitor class

role_evidence.quote: Lomustine (CCNU, CeeNU®, or Gleostine®) capsules will be administered at the institutionally-approved dose and regimen

source_quote.quote: Known to have an IDH mutation prior to enrollment
explore the effect of O\[6\] methylguanine-DNA methyltransferase (MGMT) methylation status on response to berubicin

coder_notes: MGMT status must be available at entry (inclusion 7) but no specific status is required, so coded exploratory_correlative (also an other-outcome). IDH-mutant excluded via exclusion criterion 5, coded as eligibility (IDH-wildtype requirement, never candidate-matched).
